notes: Qt 6.12.0; scene graph backend=software; platform=xcb. frame_ms = interval between consecutive QQuickWindow::frameSwapped (software: emitted by the software render loop right after QBackingStore::flush of the dirty region to the X window (xcb, MIT-SHM); RHI OpenGL: after the GL swapBuffers of the basic render loop (Mesa llvmpipe)). QT_QPA_UPDATE_IDLE_TIME=0 (documented in QWindow::requestUpdate and recommended for benchmarking in the Qt Quick Scene Graph docs; removes the default 5 ms update pacing unless --paced). Continuous redraw: each frameSwapped queues a tick that advances the script and calls QQuickWindow::update(); only frames following a tick are counted. First 2 s warm-up discarded (scripts restart at t=0). TextEdit (textFormat PlainText, readOnly, selectByMouse) in a Flickable; selectAll() at t=5 s. layout_ms = set text + force synchronous layout (contentHeight). time_to_first_display_ms = file load start -> first frameSwapped after the text was set.
version: Qt 6.12.0 (runtime 6.12.0, aqtinstall linux_gcc_64 from download.qt.io), g++ 13.3.0, CMake 4.4.4, Ninja 1.13.2
